ideas.text: An AI that writes your self-promotion one-pager for people who'd rather die than brag about themselves.
A bot that detects when 'the timing isn't right' has been said for 3 consecutive cycles and initiates a timeline inquiry.
An app that tracks every win you've had this year so your review isn't just vibes and a vague feeling of effort.
A tool that identifies which of your accomplishments are invisible to the people who decide promotions.
An AI that detects when you've been 'almost ready' for 18 months and drafts a direct conversation request.
A bot that monitors your LinkedIn for signs that recruiters smell stagnation and alerts you before they reach out first.
An app that maps your internal political capital and tells you where you're overinvested and where you're broke.
A tool that translates 'you need more executive presence' into three behaviors you can actually do on Monday.
An AI that identifies who needs to know your name before your promo goes into calibration.
A bot that detects when your manager has no idea how to advocate for you and drafts their calibration speech for them.
An app that calculates how much revenue-adjacent work you'd need to do to stop being promoted on 'potential.'
A tool that detects when a peer was promoted over you and figures out the real reason before you make assumptions.
An AI that converts your job description into what you're actually doing and identifies the level gap.
A bot that detects when a stretch assignment is just unpaid extra work with no path to recognition attached.
An app that tracks every piece of glowing feedback you've received and surfaces it automatically when you forget.
A tool that estimates your promotion probability from the trajectory of your manager's own career.
An AI that identifies when you're doing two people's jobs for one person's pay and generates the math.
A bot that detects when 'we value your contributions' precedes a 0% raise and files the sarcasm.
An app that tracks how many times you've been looped in to fix something versus asked to lead something.
A tool that detects when your sponsor stopped bringing up your name in rooms you're not in.
An AI that generates a promotion case strong enough that your manager can't lose the calibration argument.
A bot that detects when a lateral move is actually a promotion with a different name and fewer benefits.
An app that schedules your raise conversation for the exact 2-week window when your manager is most likely to say yes.
A tool that identifies when 'we need to see you do it consistently' means 'we're not paying you more yet.'
An AI that tracks your contributions to shared wins and prevents other people from listing them as solo achievements.
A bot that detects when a company's leveling framework hasn't been updated since the founding team was 5 people.
An app that estimates the probability your current manager will still work here when your next promo cycle opens.
A tool that detects when you're doing senior-level work at a mid-level salary and calculates the delta in real time.
An AI that identifies the 3 highest-visibility projects in the next quarter and asks if your name is attached to any.
A bot that detects when a promotion was given to the person who was loudest, not the person who was best.
An app that tracks how many people at your level have been promoted in the last 12 months and what they had in common.
A tool that converts 'you're not ready' into specific evidence-based gaps with a realistic timeline to close them.
An AI that detects when you're being managed out slowly and gives you a 90-day head start.
A bot that detects when an internal move is your fastest promotion path and identifies the exact role.
An app that monitors calibration outcomes across your company and detects systemic bias in promotion rates.
A tool that detects when your title has inflated without your comp keeping up and sends a market rate comparison.
An AI that generates a '30-60-90 day visibility plan' that doesn't require you to become someone you hate.
A bot that detects when you've shipped 3 major projects with no public recognition and drafts a note to your manager.
An app that monitors the gap between your contributions and your credit over time.
A tool that detects when a new senior hire gets the title you've been waiting 2 years for and helps you process it.
An AI that identifies when the promotion goalposts moved without anyone telling you and documents the shift.
A bot that detects when your development plan is more about fixing weaknesses than amplifying what you're actually great at.
An app that converts 'take on more ownership' into specific things that would count as ownership in calibration.
A tool that estimates whether staying for another year is worth more than leaving at a higher title now.
An AI that detects when your manager is protecting the team budget by not promoting you.
A bot that generates a list of sponsors you should cultivate before the next review cycle opens.
An app that detects when a promotion was withdrawn after a reorg and helps you restart the conversation.
A tool that identifies when external hiring for a role you could fill suggests your company doesn't see you.
An AI that detects when 'let's revisit this in 6 months' is being said for the third time in a row.
A bot that tracks every time your work is cited by someone more senior and builds your attribution record automatically.
An app that detects when another cycle has passed without a conversation about your growth and schedules one.
A tool that converts your brag document into the format your company's promo committee actually uses.
An AI that detects when the company leveling criteria were quietly changed right before your expected promotion.
A bot that tells you which 3 meetings to get yourself invited to before the next calibration.
An app that detects when your manager's answer to 'what does success look like at the next level?' changes every quarter.
